label: Aquatic animals, aquaculture and fisheries traceability
description: Fish, shellfish, crustacean, and aquatic species identification using stock records, vessel licensing, batch traceability, and aquaculture registration systems. Covers aquatic animal health, fisheries management, sustainability, environmental protection, and seafood trade controls.
